Title: Get all products
Expected result: HTTP 200. JSON with a non-empty "products" array.
Actual result: HTTP 200, body responseCode 200, 34 products.

Title: Product objects follow the documented shape
Expected result: Every product has id (number), name, price, brand (strings) and category.usertype.usertype + category.category.
Actual result: All 34 products match, e.g. {"id":1,"name":"Blue Top","price":"Rs. 500","brand":"Polo",...}. Note: price is a display string ("Rs. 500"), not a number (Q-03).

Title: Product ids are unique
Expected result: No duplicate id values.
Actual result: 34 distinct ids.

Title: POST to products list is rejected
Expected result: HTTP 405 "This request method is not supported." (as documented).
Actual result: HTTP 200; the 405 only appears as responseCode inside the body.

Title: DELETE to products list is rejected
Expected result: HTTP 405.
Actual result: HTTP 200 with responseCode 405 in the body.

Title: Get all brands
Expected result: HTTP 200. JSON with a "brands" array of {id, brand}.
Actual result: HTTP 200, 34 entries, shape correct.

Title: Each brand appears once
Expected result: Brand names are unique (the list is used to build the brand filter).
Actual result: 34 entries but only 8 distinct brand names; the list repeats a brand once per product.

Title: PUT to brands list is rejected
Expected result: HTTP 405.
Actual result: HTTP 200 with responseCode 405 in the body.

Title: Search by keyword
Expected result: HTTP 200. Only products related to "top".
Actual result: 14 products. Includes two shirts ("Little Girls Mr. Panda Shirt", "Colour Blocked Shirt") which match on category "Tops & Shirts" rather than name (Q-01).

Title: Search is case-insensitive
Expected result: Same results as lower case.
Actual result: 14 products, same as API-SRC-01.

Title: Search with no match
Expected result: HTTP 200 with an empty products array.
Actual result: 0 products, no error.

Title: Search with an empty value
Expected result: Behaviour is not documented. Either 400 (like a missing parameter) or an empty result.
Actual result: Returns all 34 products (Q-02).

Title: Missing search parameter
Expected result: HTTP 400 "Bad request, search_product parameter is missing in POST request."
Actual result: Correct message, but HTTP 200 with responseCode 400 in the body.

Title: SQL meta-characters are handled safely
Expected result: No server error, no extra data returned.
Actual result: HTTP 200, 0 products.

Title: Script tags are not reflected
Expected result: No error; input is not echoed back unescaped.
Actual result: HTTP 200, 0 products, input not reflected.

Title: GET is not allowed on search
Expected result: HTTP 405.
Actual result: HTTP 200 with responseCode 405 in the body.

Title: Verify login with valid credentials
Expected result: HTTP 200 "User exists!"
Actual result: Needs a dedicated test account (see execution report).

Title: Missing email parameter
Expected result: HTTP 400 "Bad request, email or password parameter is missing in POST request."
Actual result: Correct message, HTTP 200 with responseCode 400 in the body.

Title: Missing password parameter
Expected result: HTTP 400 with the same message.

Title: DELETE is not allowed on verifyLogin
Expected result: HTTP 405.
Actual result: HTTP 200 with responseCode 405 in the body.

Title: Unknown user
Expected result: HTTP 404 "User not found!"

Title: Wrong password for an existing user
Expected result: Same response as an unknown user, so valid emails cannot be discovered.

Title: Create an account with all fields
Request: POST /api/createAccount  name, email, password, title, birth_date/month/year, firstname, lastname, company, address1/2, country, zipcode, state, city, mobile_number
Expected result: HTTP 201 "User created!"

Title: Duplicate email is rejected
Expected result: 4xx with a clear "already exists" message; no second account.

Title: Missing mandatory field
Request: POST /api/createAccount  without email (then without password, name...)
Expected result: HTTP 400 naming the missing parameter.

Title: Invalid email format
Expected result: HTTP 400; account not created.

Title: Get account details by email
Expected result: HTTP 200 with the details sent at creation. The password must not be returned.

Title: Account details: missing email
Expected result: HTTP 400 "Bad request, email parameter is missing in GET request."
Actual result: Correct message, HTTP 200 with responseCode 400 in the body.

Title: Account details: unknown email
Expected result: HTTP 404.

Title: Update an account
Expected result: HTTP 200 "User updated!"; API-ACC-05 then returns the new city.

Title: Update with a wrong password is refused
Expected result: Rejected; account unchanged.

Title: Delete with a wrong password is refused
Expected result: Rejected; account still exists.

Title: Delete an account
Expected result: HTTP 200 "Account deleted!"; verifyLogin then reports "User not found!".

Title: Delete an account that no longer exists
Expected result: HTTP 404.

Title: JSON responses declare a JSON content type
Expected result: Content-Type: application/json
Actual result: Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 on every endpoint tested.

Title: Allow header matches supported methods
Expected result: Allow lists only methods the endpoint really supports (GET).
Actual result: HEAD gets a real 405, but Allow says "GET, OPTIONS, PUT, POST, DELETE" while PUT/POST/DELETE answer "not supported".

Title: API is only served over HTTPS
Expected result: Redirect (301/308) to https://, and a Strict-Transport-Security header on HTTPS responses.
Actual result: Plain HTTP answers 200 with data, no redirect; no HSTS header.

Title: Response time for read endpoints
Request: GET productsList, GET brandsList, POST searchProduct
Expected result: Under 2 s per call from a home broadband connection.
Actual result: First call 1.7 s (cold), then 0.4 to 0.6 s.
